children: Halma's upgrade to profit margin guidance is good, but the absence of a growth upgrade for photonics might be a disappointment, J.P. Morgan analysts say. The U.K. maker of health and safety equipment reiterated its low double-digit organic revenue growth guidance, which includes a 5-percentage-point contribution from photonics. The photonics unit is still expected to grow around 30% this year, JPM says. However, the margin upgrade means JPM expects the consensus adjusted earnings before interest and tax forecast to rise by a mid-single-digit percentage. Shares are up 0.1%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
